title: This Progressive is Vying to Become Florida’s First Black Senator on Tuesday
author: Team Zeteo
content:
**Angie Nixon** , a progressive who was [recently
endorsed](https://www.miamitimesonline.com/news/florida/barack-obama-endorses-
angie-nixon-for-senate/article_6f489177-d065-4b6b-899c-0cc3ef1f620d.html) by
former President Barack Obama, is vying to become the first Democrat to win a
Senate seat in Florida since 2012, and the state's first Black senator.

Nixon's campaign is calling for Medicare for All, [abolishing
ICE](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/aug/22/angie-nixon-compares-
ice-agents-modern-day-slave-
catchers/?srsltid=AYCX9vIbxYsclJLAP6epVdj2cIJfC0oeB4yNFGA9LP_k9wvdLPgRpYT2),
raising the federal minimum wage, and more. But it's going to be tough for the
Florida state rep: she's been consistently
[polling](https://floridapolitics.com/archives/827489-final-st-pete-polls-
ashley-moody-holds-49-to-45-over-angie-nixon-with-a-cushion-that-shrinks-if-
republicans-stay-home/) several points behind her Republican opponent,
incumbent Ashley Moody.

With the midterm elections just days away, Nixon joins **Mehdi** to discuss
her campaign, why Moody refuses to debate her, and her [recent
allegations](https://x.com/AngieNixon/status/2115113489127882990) that Moody
is sending people to Nixon's bookstore to harass her family and staff members.
Zeteo reached out to Moody's campaign for comment about the accusation but
didn't hear back.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" This is what people like Ashley Moody do," **Nixon says.** "They like to
distract against their policies, their failed policies, and place targets on
people's backs."**

Also during the interview, Mehdi and Nixon discuss:

  * Her response to Bari Weiss-run CBS News [mischaracterizing](https://x.com/AngieNixon/status/2114887353391054992) her comments on Cuba ("**This isn 't the first time**")

  * Far-right Trump ally Laura Loomer's disgusting and racist attacks against her

  * Whether or not she is a socialist, given her recent membership of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA)

  * Why she [told](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/article/angie-nixon-florida-midterms-senate-national-democrats.html) _New York Magazine_ she's considering leaving the Democratic Party after the election (**" We don't have a Black agenda.**")
